headline: Turkish Credit Card Spending Climbs 35% to 2.5 Trillion Liras
summary: Credit card payments in Türkiye rose 35% year-on-year to 2.5 trillion liras ($50.3 billion) in September, forming the majority of total card spending.
why: Credit card volumes serve as a direct gauge of domestic consumer demand and inflationary pressures within the Turkish retail economy.

impacts.name: Turkish Retail Banking
impacts.why: Higher credit card transaction volumes generate increased fee income for financial institutions.
